title: Protocol for Flow Cytometric Detection of Immune Cell Infiltration in the Epidermis and Dermis of a Psoriasis Mouse Model
protocol: Shave a 1.5 cm × 2 cm area on mouse back skin using an electric pet shaver.
Weigh 60 mg of 5% IMQ cream and apply it gently and evenly to the shaved skin area.
Repeat steps 1 and 3 every day for 5 days.
Smear the IMQ cream to mouse skin gently and evenly with a pair of curved forceps.
Euthanize the mice by CO2 inhalation after 6 days of IMQ application.
Collect skin samples from mouse back and ears.
Cut off a 1 cm × 1 cm area from mouse back skin if IMQ was applied.
Transfer the skin to an EP tube containing 1 ml HBSS.
Wash the skin rigorously in HBSS for 15 seconds by shaking up and down.
Transfer the skin to a new EP tube.
Refresh with HBSS.
Wash off remaining IMQ cream by repeating steps 1 and 2 two times.
Cut the back-skin sample into four triangular pieces along the diagonals.
Split the dorsal and ventral sections of the ear with forceps if processing ears.
Digest the skin with 1 mL of Dispase II working solution in one well of a 12-well plate at 37°C for 1 hour.
Pre-chill HBSS at 4°C.
Transfer the skin to a petri dish containing 10 mL of cold HBSS.
Separate the epidermis from the dermis using curved forceps.
Wash the epidermis with cold HBSS three times.
Transfer the epidermis to one well of a 12-well plate containing 1 mL cold HBSS and place the plate at 4°C.
Wash the dermis with cold HBSS three times.
Transfer the dermis to one well of a 6-well plate placed on ice containing 1 mL of cold Dermis Dissociation Buffer.
Cut the dermis into pieces as small as possible (< 0.5 mm in size) with curved scissors in 1 mL of cold Dermis Dissociation Buffer in a 6-well plate placed on ice.
Add another 2 mL of Dermis Dissociation Buffer to an ear sample or  2.5 mL of Dermis Dissociation Buffer to a back-skin sample.
Incubate the sample in a 37°C cell culture incubator for 30 min.
Cut the top end (5 mm long) of a 1-mL pipet tip with scissors and gently mix the tissue suspension by pipetting.
Incubate the sample in a 37°C cell culture incubator for another 30 min.
Cut the top end of a 1-mL pipet tip to be 5 mm long using scissors.
Gently mix the tissue suspension by pipetting to ensure no obvious debris remains.
If debris is visible, continue incubating at 37°C for an additional 10–30 minutes until debris disappears after pipetting. Check every 10 minutes.
Pass the suspension through a 40-μm cell strainer into a 50-mL tube.
Rinse the well with 2 mL DMEM/high glucose containing 10% FBS and pass this rinse through the strainer to join the previous sample in the 50-mL tube.
Add 10 mL DMEM/high glucose containing 10% FBS to wash the sample through the strainer into the same 50-mL tube.
Filter the sample through the strainer by gravity without applying additional forces.
Transfer the suspension to a 15-mL conical centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C, discard supernatant, and resuspend pellet with 2 mL cold Staining Buffer.
Centrifuge again at 400 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C, discard supernatant, and resuspend pellet in 90 μL cold Staining Buffer.
Transfer the sample to a 5-mL round-bottom flow test tube.
Keep the sample on ice until staining is performed.
Transfer the epidermis from HBSS to a new well of the 12-well plate.
Cut the epidermis into small pieces (∼2 mm in size) with scissors and squeeze the remaining HBSS to avoid unintended dilution of the TE buffer.
Transfer the sample to the TE Buffer.
Incubate at 37°C water bath for 5 min.
Shake the sample up and down for five times.
Continue incubation at 37°C water bath for 5 min.
Add 1 mL cold trypsin neutralizing solution (4°C) to the sample.
Pipette rigorously for five times.
Pass the suspension through a 40-μm cell strainer into a new 50-mL tube.
Rinse the 2-mL tube with 2 mL of cold HBSS and pass the suspension through the strainer into the same 50-mL tube.
Use 5 mL of cold HBSS to pass through the strainer to wash the sample.
Transfer the suspension to a 15-mL conical centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet with 2 mL cold Staining Buffer.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet with 90 μL cold Staining Buffer.
Transfer the sample to a 5-mL round-bottom flow test tube.
Keep on ice until staining.
Stain cell suspensions with indicated antibodies for flow cytometric analysis.
Set up an unstained control by aspirating 20 μL from a dermis sample into a tube labeled “Blank” and adding 180 μL Staining Buffer.
Generate a DAPI-single-stained control by aspirating 20 μL from a dermis sample to a tube labeled “DAPI” and adding 180 μL DAPI Buffer.
Mix UltraComp eBeads™ Compensation Beads thoroughly by vortexing.
Add 1 drop of the beads to an empty labeled tube for each fluorochrome.
Add 0.5 μL of the relevant antibody to the bead-containing tube.
Mix well by flicking and incubate at 4°C for 15 min in the dark.
Add 2 mL Staining Buffer, vortex briefly, and centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet with 200 μL Staining Buffer.
Adjust epidermis and dermis sample volumes to 90 μL with Staining Buffer.
Dilute Fc block at a dilution of 1:20 with Staining Buffer.
Add 10 μL of the diluted Fc block to each sample and incubate at 4°C for 10 min in the dark.
Mix indicated antibodies in an EP tube as specified (Table 1).
Add 4 μL of the antibody mix (without DAPI) to the 100-μL sample, vortex briefly, and incubate at 4°C for 30 min in the dark.
Add 2 mL Staining Buffer, vortex briefly, and centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Optional: Use BD Cytofix/Cytoperm™ Fixation/Permeabilization Solution Kit to process the sample if intracellular cytokines are to be detected.
Optional: Use eBioscience™ Foxp3 / Transcription Factor Staining Buffer Set to process the sample if transcription factors are to be detected.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet with 200 μL DAPI Buffer.
Keep the sample on ice until detection.
Collect data using a BD LSRFortessa™ cell analyzer.
Select parameters including FSC-A, FSC-H, FSC-W, SSC-A, SSC-H, SSC-W, Alexa Fluor 700-A (CD45), FITC-A (CD3), APC-A (CD11b), PE-A (F4/80), BV510-A (CD11c), PerCP-Cy5.5-A (Ly6G) and BV421-A (DAPI).
Use the unstained control and single-stained controls to set PMT voltages.
Adjust compensations using BD FACSDiva software.
Collect a total of 5,000 events from the unstained control and each single-stained control.
Create gates for the samples.
Set “Storage Gate” value to “All Events,” “Events to Record” value to 10,000, and “Stopping Gate” value to “P4” (CD45+ cells).
Collect data.
Set "Events to Record" value to 10,000.
Set “Stopping Gate” value to “P4” (CD45+ cells).
Gate CD45+ cells from DAPI- live cells.
Gate CD3+ cells from CD45+ cells.
Gate CD11c+ cells from CD45+ cells.
Gate CD11b+Ly6G+ cells from CD45+ cells.
Gate CD11b+F4/80+ cells from CD45+ cells.
Collect all cells in the epidermis samples and untreated back-skin dermis.
Analyze data with FlowJo software.
Gate away dead cells, which have autofluorescence.
Use dermis sample as unstained control.
Stain CD45 with Alexa Fluor 700.
